skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain phenomena related to internship activities based on learned theories.
Apply theories to evaluate and propose solutions, presenting them in written and oral form.
Demonstrate effective communication skills in a working environment, especially in foreign environments.
Show ability to work independently and effectively in teams according to assigned tasks at the internship site.
Practice skills in collecting information and analyzing human resource management activities in an organization.
Demonstrate ability to make judgments, evaluations, and propose solutions for issues in specialized fields.
Enhance self-study and research capabilities with innovative approaches in assigned tasks.
Demonstrate autonomy in planning, coordinating, and completing assigned tasks.
